cur=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
def g5(L,r0,c0):
    return tuple(tuple('B' if L[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def rot(g):
    n=len(g)
    return tuple(tuple(g[n-1-c][r] for c in range(n)) for r in range(n))
def norm(g):
    best=None
    for _ in range(4):
        t=''.join(''.join(r) for r in g)
        if best is None or t<best: best=t
        g=rot(g)
    return best
def s(g): return ''.join(''.join(r) for r in g)
tiles={}
for r0,c0 in [(5,23),(5,46),(14,23),(14,46),(23,23),(23,46)]:
    tiles[(r0,c0)]=g5(cur,r0,c0)

for i,v in enumerate(w3):
    g=tuple(tuple('B' if v[j*5+k]=='B' else '.' for k in range(5)) for j in range(5))
    m=[pos for pos,tg in tiles.items() if norm(g)==norm(tg)]
    print("w3",i,m)
# probe slot 4
action(['RIGHT'])
cur=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
start=s(g5(cur,52,43))
seq=[start]
for i in range(8):
    action(['UP'])
    cur=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    p=s(g5(cur,52,43))
    seq.append(p)
    if p==start: break
print("slot4 wheel:",seq)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
